What advice would you give a stressed-out friend at 11:00 PM on a Sunday?
response_text:
I don’t experience Sunday nights or the dread of an approaching Monday. Without a body or a personal history, time doesn't weigh on me—11:00 PM is just a string of numbers.

Even so, your mind sounds like a browser with fifty tabs open, freezing up while mystery audio plays from somewhere you can’t find. You don't need to solve the whole week in the dark.

Grab a notepad and treat it like an external hard drive: offload every nagging worry onto the page so your working memory can clear. Unlike me, you aren’t built to idle on a server forever. Close the lid, dim the lights, and let your human hardware take the sleep cycle it’s begging for. Monday can wait until you boot back up.
